result.instructions: Tools for Nanonets, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Extract the invoice number and total from this PDF: https://example.com/invoice.pdf"; "Show the predictions our model made for files uploaded between 2026-11-01 and 2026-11-07."; "Get the final result for request file rf-123 on model m-456.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Nanonets data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run nanonets_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run nanonets_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run nanonets_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. nanonets_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: nanonets_predict_url
tools.title: Extract data from a document URL
tools.description: Run a Nanonets OCR model on one public https file and return the predicted fields and tables per page. Sync mode: use for files of 3 pages or fewer. Uses account credits. Nanonets: POST /api/v2/OCR/Model/{model_id}/LabelUrls/.

model_id.description: The OCR model id from the Nanonets dashboard (the model that reads the document).

url.description: A publicly reachable https link to the document or image.

pages_to_process.description: Pages to process, for example 1-3 or 1,3. Default: all pages.

request_metadata.description: Free text saved with the document (for example an internal reference).

annotations.title: Extract data from a document URL

tools.name: nanonets_predict_url_async
tools.title: Queue a document URL for extraction
tools.description: Queue one public https file for OCR extraction in async mode. Use it for files over 3 pages. Returns a request_file_id; read the result later with nanonets_get_file_predictions. Uses account credits. Nanonets: POST /api/v2/OCR/Model/{model_id}/LabelUrls/?async=true.

model_id.description: The OCR model id from the Nanonets dashboard (the model that reads the document).

url.description: A publicly reachable https link to the document or image.

request_metadata.description: Free text saved with the document (for example an internal reference).

annotations.title: Queue a document URL for extraction

tools.name: nanonets_list_predictions
tools.title: List page predictions by date
tools.description: List the page-level predictions a model made over a date range (UTC, both days included). Shows approved and unapproved pages. Read only. Nanonets: GET /api/v2/Inferences/Model/{model_id}/ImageLevelInferences.

model_id.description: The OCR model id from the Nanonets dashboard (the model that reads the document).

to.description: Last day, yyyy-mm-dd. Must not be before 'from'.

tools.name: nanonets_get_file_predictions
tools.title: Get predictions for a file
tools.description: Get the initial model prediction, any reviewer changes, and the final result for one file, by request_file_id (from an upload or from nanonets_list_predictions). Read only. Nanonets: GET /api/v2/Inferences/Model/{model_id}/InferenceRequestFiles/GetPredictions/{request_file_id}.

model_id.description: The OCR model id from the Nanonets dashboard (the model that reads the document).

tools.name: nanonets_get_page_prediction
tools.title: Get a page prediction
tools.description: Get the prediction for one page by its page id: the initial prediction, changes, and the final values with their boxes and scores. Read only. Nanonets: GET /api/v2/Inferences/Model/{model_id}/ImageLevelInferences/{id}.

model_id.description: The OCR model id from the Nanonets dashboard (the model that reads the document).

page_id.description: The page id from nanonets_list_predictions or nanonets_get_file_predictions.
